 Small osteochondral body, about intact9xintact4cm. at anterior infrapatellar recess.

alteraciones significativas.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona
contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.

cuerpo, sin desplazamiento de segmentos.
Úlcera condral de espesor total de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral que mide
aproximadamente 6 x 5 mm en sus ejes mediolateral y anteroposterior, sin cambios óseos
secundarios. Fina úlcera condral focal de espesor total del aspecto posterior de platillo tibial
lateral. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y patelofemorales sin alteraciones.

intermuscular en la región poplítea.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura espesor y ancho total del LCA.
Rotura radial incompleta de la unión del cuerno posterior con el cuerpo del menisco lateral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral, previamente descritas.

Label: ACL
Report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ - Στο έσω διαμέρισμα παρατηρείται εκφυλιστική ρήξη στο οπίσθιο κέρας και σώμα του μηνίσκου. Επιπλέον παρατηρείται ήπιο οστεομυελικό οίδημα και πλήρης εξάλειψη του αρθρικού χόνδρου (ICRS Grade IV) στον έσω κνημιαίο κόνδυλο, ενώ συνυπάρχουν μικρής έκτασης επιχείλια οστεόφυτα στον μηριαίο και κνημιαίο κόνδυλο. - Από τον έλεγχο του έξω διαμερίσματος παρατηρείται ήπιο οστεομυελικό οίδημα στον έξω κνημιαίο κόνδυλο. - Από τον έλεγχο του πρόσθιου διαμερίσματος δεν σημειώνονται παθολογικά ευρήματα. - Φυσιολογικά απεικονίζονται οι πλάγιοι και χιαστοί σύνδεσμοί. - Παρατηρείται μέτρια ποσότητα υγρού ενδαρθρικά που συνέχεται με ευμεγέθη πολύχωρη συνοβιακή κύστη Baker κεφαλουραίας διαμέτρου 9,7εκ παρά την έσω κεφαλή του γαστροκνημίου μυός. Συμπέρασμα 1. Εκφυλιστική οστεοαρθρίτιδα και εκφυλισττική ρήξη του μηνίσκου στο έσω διαμέρισμα. 2. Μικροδοκιδώδη κατάγματα ανεπάρκειας (συνώνυμο SONK) έσω κνημιαιίου και σε μικρότερη έκταση πρόσθιου έξω κνημιαίου κονδύλου. ∆εν παρατηρείται καθίζηση της αρθρικής επιφάνειας.

Label: ACL
RepresentativeEvidence: Grade 2 injury of anterior cruciate ligament.
Report:
> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> Split fractures at tibial plateau with depression of the lateral articular surface and extending to tibial intercondylar region
> Bone contusion with neglected fracture line at fibular head.
> The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> There are linear signal intensity in anterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Medial meniscus appears to be normal.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Some joint effusion

Impression: 
1. C/W Tibia plateau fracutre and fibular head fracture with bone contusion.
2. Grade 2 injury of anterior cruciate ligament.
3. Tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

medial. Úlceras condrales espesor parcial de la región central del platillo tibial lateral. Condropatía
superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total de distribución difusa de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.

Signos de una rotura del menisco medial, no desplazada.
Rotura compleja del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral con mínima extrusión y
edema de las partes blandas regionales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial y del
platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía superficial del resto de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the lumbar knee was performed on a 3.0 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Minimal degenerative subchondral bone marrow edema is present at the lateral tibiofemoral compartment related to overlying chondrosis. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate-sized Baker cyst with slight surrounding edema likely representing leakage.

There are postoperative changes anteriorly consistent with previous arthroscopic surgery.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a diminutive appearance of the body and posterior horn consistent with previous partial meniscectomy. There is irregularity of the inner margin diffusely consistent with recurrent tear. There is moderate extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the posterior and peripheral weightbearing aspect, with minimal degenerative subchondral bone marrow edema.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and surface irregularity at the patella and trochlea, medial greater than lateral.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinosis with diffuse thickening.
Patella tendon: Moderate tendinosis with diffuse thickening.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

A thickened medial patellar plica is present, extending into the patellofemoral compartment.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

[REDACTED]. Lateral compartment chondrosis appears new or increased. Otherwise, no significant interval change.

IMPRESSION:

1. Previous partial lateral meniscectomy with recurrent tear.
2. Chondrosis in the patellofemoral and lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis.
4. Thickened medial patellar plica.
5. Small joint effusion. Moderate Baker cyst with evidence of leakage.

ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Από τον έλεγχο των χιαστών και πλαγίων συνδέσμων δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήματα. Απλή εκφύλιση παρατηρείται στον έξω μηνίσκο. Μόλις αναγνωρίζεται οστεομυελικό οίδημα στην άπω επίφυση του μηριαίου οστού και στην εγγύς επίφυση της κνήμης. Συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά με κατά τόπους πάχυνση του υμένα. Λόγω της ήπιας υμενίτιδας συνιστάται ρευματολογικός έλεγχος για διερεύνηση πιθανής υποκείμενης φλεγμονώδους αρθρίτιδας. Το μόλις αναγνωρίσιμο οστεομυελικό οίδημα στις επιφύσεις περιαρθρικά, θα μπορούσε να αποδοθεί σε αρχόμενο μικροδοκιδώδες κάταγμα ανεπάρκειας χωρίς καθίζηση της αρθρικής επιφάνειας.

Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά σε επικοινωνία με μικρή συνοβιακή κύστη Baker.

Report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normal. Medial menisküs ekstrüde görünümde olup posterior hornunda yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur. Arka çapraz bağ, çm çapraz bağ , lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Tibia proksimali ve femur distal epikondil seviyesi medialde kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu görünümler mevcuttur. Bu düzeyde eklem aralığı belirgin daralmıştır.Popliteal fossada 54x15 mm çapta Baker kisti ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.

Label: ACL
RepresentativeEvidence: ACL rupture.
Report:
No evidence of knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears. ACL is ruptured. There is mild anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau in relation to femur. Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism. The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. A bone contusion is noted in the posterolateral corner of the lateral tibial plateau. 
Conclusion: Mild effusion. ACL rupture. Posterolateral tibial contusion.

Label: ACL
RepresentativeEvidence: Ön çapraz bağ devamlılığı seçilememiştir (komplet yırtık).
Report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade II dejenerasyon, radial yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur. Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon, kova sapı yırtığı ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur. Arka çaprazda fokal sinyal artışları mevcuttur. Ön çapraz bağ devamlılığı seçilememiştir (komplet yırtık). Lateral ve medial kollateral ligamanlar çevresinde hafif ödematöz görünüm (grade I sprain) izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendon normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patella normal yerleşimlidir.İnfrapatellar yağ yastıkçığında ödematöz görünüm izlenmiştir.Suprapatellar bursada ve diz eklemi içerisinde yaygın sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Femur lateral kondil ve tibia lateral plato seviyesinde yaygın kontüzyonel kemik iliği ödemleri izlenmiştir. Ayrıca fibula baş düzeyinde subkondral ve patellar kemik medullada kemik iliği ödemleri izlendi.

Ευρήματα: - Εκτεταμένο οίδημα του οστικού μυελού στην εγγύς μετάφυση/επίφυση της κνήμης παριστά οστικό μώλωπα στο πλαίσιο της αναφερόμενης κάκωσης. - Οιδηματώδης απεικόνιση του πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου με ασυνέχεια των ινών του στο πλαίσιο υφολικής (σχεδόν πλήρους) ρήξης. - Οιδηματώδης απεικόνιση και ασυνέχεια στην εγγύς μοίρα του έσω πλαγίου συνδέσμου με παρουσία οιδήματος πέριξ στο πλαίσιο μερικής ρήξης (grade 2). - Ικανή ποσότητα ενθαρθρικής συλλογής υγρού. - Συλλογή υγρού προεπιγονατιδικά στο πλαίσιο προεπιγονατιδικής ορογονοθυλακίτιδας. - Εκφύλιση παρατηρείται στο οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω μηνίσκου. - Λέπτυνση και ανωμαλία παρυφής του αρθρικού χόνδρου ιδίως στο έσω μεσάρθριο και στον έσω αρθρικό χόνδρο της επιγονατίδας στο πλαίσιο αρχόμενης οστεοαρθρίτιδας. - Από τον έλεγχο του εκτατικού μηχανισμού και του λοιπού αρθρικού χόνδρου δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήματα.

Label: ACL
RepresentativeEvidence: ACL tear.
Report:
MRI of Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Screen Save, Ax T2 FS

* The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increased signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
* High signal in the soft tissue medial to the medial collateral ligament with increased signal intensity of proximal ligament (deep MCL/meniscofemoral ligament), in favor of grade 2 injury.
* High signal in the soft tissue surrounding the medial and lateral patellar retinaculum, in favor of grade 1 injury.
* Linear signal intensity in the body and posterior horn of medial meniscus with extension to the surface, in favor of tear.
* There is a gap in the posterior horn of lateral meniscus near the posterior root (Sr/Im: [ID]; [ID].
* Bone marrow edema in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula, and lower pole of patella, suspect bone contusion.
 A subchondral linear hypointensity over posterior aspect of medial tibial plateau on T1WI and F/S T2WI, without associated contour deformity (Sr/Im: [ID]; [ID].
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
* Irregular contour of the posterior joint capsule with interstitial high signal intensity, suspect joint capsular injury/tear.
* Subcutaneous edema in distal thigh to proximal leg and intermuscular edema in the popliteal fossa.

Impression:
1. ACL tear.
2. Grade 2 injury of MCL (especially at the deep MCL/meniscofemoral ligament). 
 Suspect grade 1 injury of medial and lateral patellar retinaculum.
3. Meniscal tear in the body and posterior horn of medial meniscus; suspect posterior root tear of lateral meniscus.
4. Bone contusion in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula, and lower pole of patella.
 Subchondral fracture over posterior aspect of medial tibial plateau (Sr/Im: [ID]; [ID].
5. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
6. Irregular contour of the posterior joint capsule, suspect joint capsular injury/tear.
7. Subcutaneous edema in distal thigh to proximal leg and intermuscular edema in the popliteal fossa.

Suggest correlated with clinical manifestation and further management.

Iregularna, blago udubljena medijalna kontura patele u području apeksa, moguće u sklopu
impresijske frakture. Opsežan okolni koštani edem.
U području lateralnog kondila femura anteriorno od hvatišta tetive m. popliteus nalazi se
također udubljena kontura kosti na arealu oko 9 mm u promjeru, opisano može odgovarati
impresijskoj frakturi. Opsežan okolni koštani edem.
Zadebljanje i edem medijalnog patelarnog retinakuluma uz prekid kontinuiteta vlakana u
središnjem dijelu u sklopu rupture. Manja količina izljeva suprapatelarno i u medijalnom recesusu
uz naglašeniji suprapatelarni masni jastučić.
Opisane promjene najvjerojatnije posljedično lateralnoj dislokaciji patele.
Manja inzula kompakte u lateralnom kondilu femura i tibije.
Hondromalacične promjene 1. stupnja hrskavice medijalne fasete patele.

patelarnog ligamenta.
Kompletna suprapatelarna plika.

nakon distenzije ili manje parcijalne rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Linearni hiperintenzitet crvene zone stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koji može odgovarati
vaskularnoj strukturi, bez evidentne rupture.

Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.

Report:
Patella alta (Insall-Salvati omjer 1,5), Wiberg tip III.
Iregularna, blago udubljena medijalna kontura patele u području apeksa, moguće u sklopu
impresijske frakture. Opsežan okolni koštani edem.
U području lateralnog kondila femura anteriorno od hvatišta tetive m. popliteus nalazi se
također udubljena kontura kosti na arealu oko 9 mm u promjeru, opisano može odgovarati
impresijskoj frakturi. Opsežan okolni koštani edem.
Zadebljanje i edem medijalnog patelarnog retinakuluma uz prekid kontinuiteta vlakana u
središnjem dijelu u sklopu rupture. Manja količina izljeva suprapatelarno i u medijalnom recesusu
uz naglašeniji suprapatelarni masni jastučić.
Opisane promjene najvjerojatnije posljedično lateralnoj dislokaciji patele.
Manja inzula kompakte u lateralnom kondilu femura i tibije.
Hondromalacične promjene 1. stupnja hrskavice medijalne fasete patele.
Lateralni patelarni retinakulum održan.
Početne entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. quadriceps te patelarnog hvatišta
patelarnog ligamenta.
Kompletna suprapatelarna plika.
Prednji križni ligament je nešto viših intenziteta signala pri tibijalnom hvatištu, moguće stanje
nakon distenzije ili manje parcijalne rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Linearni hiperintenzitet crvene zone stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koji može odgovarati
vaskularnoj strukturi, bez evidentne rupture.
Lateralni menisk je primjerenih intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Entezopatske promjene i manji burzitis tetive m. popliteus.
Primjeren izgled iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.

Label: ACL
Report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco medial es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Rotura compleja degenerativa del cuerno anterior, cuerpo, cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz
meniscal posterior del menisco lateral con extrusión asociada. Edema óseo periférico posterior de
platillo tibial lateral con pequeñas fracturas subcorticales regionales.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región posterior de carga del compartimento
femorotibial lateral. Mínimos cambios óseos asociados. Condropatía superficial del compartimento
femorotibial medial y del cartílago troclear.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con mínima sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja degenerativa del cuerno anterior, cuerpo , cuerno posterior y raíz meniscal
posterior del menisco lateral con extrusión asociada.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Condropatía superficial del compartimento femorotibial medial y de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía
lesiones grado dos y tres de la rótula.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con mínima sinovitis

Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrude görünümdedir. Lateral menisküste grade I dejenerasyon izlendi. Ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışı izlendi(miksoid dejenerasyon). Arka çapraz bağda yer yer sinyal artışları izlendi(grade I sprain). Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ).Suprapatellar bursada ,diz eklemi içerisinde yaygın sıvı artışı izlendi. Femur medial kondil tibiofemoral eklem yüzüne bakan düzeyde subartiküler fraktür hattı ve komşu kemikte yaygın ödem izlendi. Bu düzeyde eklem aralığı daralmıştır. Arka çapraz bağ tibia yapışma düzeyinde subkondrial milimetrik kistler izlendi.Diz eklemi prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.

Label: ACL
Report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Esguince del ligamento colateral medial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal con pérdida parcial de la continuidad del tercio medio proximal
del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial con edema de las partes blandas
adyacentes. El resto de los componentes del complejo medial dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura. Menisco medial de
morfología conservada, con aumento de señal del meniscocapsular a su cuerno posterior.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemorales sin alteraciones.
Leve derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo, sin signos de complicación.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales. Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso,
bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos de un esguince grado II del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial.
Signos de aumento de señal meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que podría
representar una lesión parcial regional.
Leve derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales

Small knee joint effusion. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

1. High-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2. Low-grade partial tear of the medial collateral ligament.
3. Osteochondral impaction injuries posterior medial tibial plateau and posterior lateral tibial plateau without evidence of displaced or unstable osteochondral fragment.
4. Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.
5. Intact menisci.

Label: ACL
RepresentativeEvidence: Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, umjereno do teško degenerativno promijenjen.
Report:
Koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura, anterionog dijela medijalnog kondila tibije te lateralnog
tubera interkondilarne eminencije tibije.
Obzirom erozivne promjene zglobne hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba
opisano vjerojatno u sklopu OA promjena.
Prikaže se hondromalacija II° hrskavice lateralnog tibijalnog platoa te hondromalacija I°
lateralne fasete patele.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, umjereno do teško degenerativno promijenjen.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Degenerativno promijenjenmedijalni menisk, osobito u području trupa i stražnjeg roga gdje se
prati kompleksna ruptura s radijalnom i horizontalnom komponentom koja se pruža prema
femoralnoj plohi.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture blaže degenerativno promijenjen u prednjem rogu i
prednjem korijenu.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog
kontinuiteta.
Burzitis tetive popliteusa.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Inkompletna suprapatelarna plica.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Manja količina izljeva u zglob.
Baker cista veličine 22x31x37 mm (apxllxcc).

Report:
FINDINGS:

Fractures:
Known mildly comminuted undisplaced avulsion fracture of the tibial tuberosity involving the distal ACL insertion, anteriorly the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, as well as posteriorly the tibial insertion of both the posterior horn of medial and lateral menisci. The fracture involves the central portion of the medial tibial plateau articular surface anteriorly and posteriorly with articular surface collapse of 3 mm anteriorly and 5 mm posteriorly, as well as a step deformity of up to 2 mm posteriorly.
Small mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the lateral corner of lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
Small mild osteochondral impaction at the anterior lateral weightbearing aspect of lateral femoral condyle.
There is associated bone marrow edema associated with these fractures.

Joint alignment:
Mild widening of the medial femorotibial joint space. Otherwise preserved articular alignment.

Degenerative changes:
None.

Bone marrow signal:
Additional small area of bone marrow edema on the medial side of medial femoral condyle without evidence of associated fracture.

Anterior cruciate ligament: The distal bony avulsion with laxity of the ACL, showing some internal high T2 signal changes compatible with additional low-grade partial ligamentous tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Intact with mild laxity.
Medial collateral ligament: Complete tear of the superficial portion at the mid to distal third. Moderate grade partial tear of the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial components with partial meniscocapsular separation of the medial meniscal body.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: Low-grade sprain of the proximal lateral collateral ligament. The other associated structures are intact.

Medial meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes of the meniscal body, with evidence of small horizontal oblique tear extending to the femoral surface. No other significant tear. Bony avulsion of the posterior horn root insertion as detailed above.
Lateral meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes at the anterior horn compatible with low-grade tearing. Evidence of small Wrisberg rip-type longitudinal tear of the periphery of the posterior horn. Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury. There is a bony avulsion of the anterior horn and posterior horn root insertion sites.

Extensor tendons: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Moderate grade partial tear of the medial retinaculum.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corner: Diffuse signal change and mild thickening of the distal semimembranosus tendon compatible with low to moderate grade partial tearing.
Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury.

Joint effusion: Large joint effusion.
Baker cyst: None.

Other significant findings:
None.

CONCLUSION:
*Comminuted mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the tibial spine with mild comminution, including the distal insertion of the ACL, the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, and posterior horn root insertion zone of the medial and lateral menisci. Intra-articular fracture extension involving the central portion of the medial tibial plateau with small gap/step as described.
*Small mildly displaced lateral corner fracture of the lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
*Small osteochondral impaction fracture of the lateral corner of lateral femoral condyle.
*High-grade tear of the medial collateral ligament.
*Low-grade partial tear/sprain of the anterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament.
*Additional low-grade tears involving the medial and lateral menisci as described.
*Moderate grade partial tear of the medial patellar retinaculum.
*Posteromedial and posterolateral corner injuries as described.
*Large joint effusion.

RepresentativeEvidence: Пълна руптура на предна кръстна връзка.
Report:
МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се остеохондрална фрактура в областта на медиалния кондил на бедрената кост. Фрактурата се представя като хипоинтензна линия с дъговидна форма. Налице е костно-мозъчен едем в костта, както и депресия на медиалното плато. В този участък се изобразява и изтъняване на артикулиращия хрущял на кондила на протежение от около 9 мм. Костно-мозъчен едем е налице в медиалното тибиално плато, както и в отграничен участък от латералния кондил на фемура. Ставният хрущял, покриващ тибията и латералния кондил на бедрената кост, е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност.
